_note: Arrow wounds on draugr, skeletons and dragon priests: shafts sunk in dry, leathery flesh or wedged between old bones; no blood, no breath. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the point punching into dry flesh with a dull thock. Not a drop of blood follows; {name} rasps and keeps coming, the shaft jutting from {name}'s body.
, the arrowhead driving into flesh that is already split. Old bone cracks around it and grave dust puffs from the wound; {name} lets out a dry, hollow shriek.
, and the arrow sinks deep among the shafts already lodged there. Bone splinters and dust sprays out; {name} reels, the eye-light flaring and wavering.
, and it is too much. The arrow cracks through the brittle frame and {name} sags, the cold light in {name}'s eyes flickering low.
